purpose: Reviewed foreground courts and street-spines for the central Hilltop sequence. These are illustrated walkable surfaces, not new venue or amenity locations.

precincts.notes: A broad, slightly south-west-facing main-stage forecourt, rather than a small circular plaza in the middle of the Hilltop sequence.
Long, tapering Oldtown civic spine that reads as a connected street and venue run below Grand Central, not an isolated round clearing.
Small shared workshop court for the Ancient Futures, Circus, Crafts and Games cluster above the main Oldtown run.
Wide softened garden court around Botanica's clustered venues, avoiding a uniform round plaza while preserving its wooded edge.
Oblong built street court for the Metropolis venue run, so its stalls and stages read as an urban cluster rather than a round island.
Faceted civic court for the denser Area 404 complex, keeping its hard-edged built mass distinct from Botanica and Metropolis.
Long narrow high-street court beneath the Letsbe Avenue venue loop, matching its continuous street character instead of a bulbous clearing.
A broad angled stage front for Hydro XL that makes the Downtown flagship read as a deliberate destination rather than a lone marker.
Compact faceted junction court at Quantum, preserving the legible branch between Oldtown, Helix and the Lion's Den without inventing paths.
A deliberately compact pocket venue immediately east of Quantum, keeping Helix legible without giving it a headline-stage field.
A compact rounded court around the container arena so the Area 404 landmark reads as a destination, not an oversized isolated marker.
A small rounded hilltop court for the marquee, preserving the Ballroom's distinct venue scale beside the Grand Central sequence.
A narrow hard-edged yard for Hangar 161, echoing its industrial character while keeping the Area 404 cluster compact.
A modest wooded-edge clearing for Tribe of Frog, visually connected to Oldtown without adding a false camp or zoning boundary.
